no_adcom_quote.quote: This application was not referred for review to an advisory committee, because outside expertise was not necessary. There were no controversial issues that would benefit from advisory committee discussion.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for EMFLAZA (deflazacort, NDA208684). The Summary Review states the application was not referred to an advisory committee because outside expertise was not necessary and there were no controversial issues warranting AC discussion; the Cross-Discipline Team Leader review, the Medical Review, and the Office Director memo (Robert Temple) all similarly record the AC section as 'Not applicable' or that no AC meeting was needed. With no AdComm held, there are no committee-driven linkages to the approval.
